text: Figure 6.16: Information path for the loss of redundancy error In case one redundant block is invalid during read or write (1), an attempt is made by the NVRAM manager to immediately recover the NV Block using data from the incorrupt NV Block (2). If the recovery fails (3), the error code NVM_E_LOSS_OF_REDUNDANCY is reported to the DEM and the NVRAM manager sets the job result to NVM_REQ_REDUNDANCY_FAILED (4).
